summary: Hesai Group, a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed lidar maker, filed a Form 6-K furnished with its November 2026 monthly return (HKEX Form FF301) on movements in securities for the month ended 31 October 2026, signed by CEO Yifan Li. It reports no change in authorised or issued share capital: 215,990,888 Class A and 1,045,146,800 Class B ordinary shares, both unchanged month-over-month, zero treasury shares, and confirms compliance with the 15% minimum public float. This is a routine HKEX monthly securities-movement disclosure, the US-equivalent periodic share-capital update, not a special situation; no deal terms, no arbitrage angle.
